review_policy.evidence_rule: Only case reasoning-span references may support a source-level method association candidate. Conclusion and outcome spans are preserved for lineage but never used to propose a method binding.
review_policy.target_scope_rule: A source-level method association is not an executable target binding. Existing MethodPattern target_domains and Method Policy execution dispositions are authoritative and remain unchanged.
review_policy.symbolic_boundary: WT-METHOD-005 and WT-METHOD-006 remain deferred to a symbolic/canonical adapter.
review_policy.temporal_boundary: A target_time_label must be explicitly bound before a temporal method can become a case-target runtime binding.

rationale: All six MethodPatterns retain abstract target domains (GLOBAL_PROFILE, TEMPORAL_INFERENCE, SYMBOLIC_INFERENCE); none exactly matches the 12 concrete case target domains.
Source spans can support source-level method association candidates, but they do not by themselves satisfy the existing runtime target-domain contract.
The structured case graphs are minimal CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY graphs and do not encode the required typed related-palace or target-time bindings.
The 11 real-engine chart artifacts verify only source-reviewed target-palace identity and fourteen-major-star anchors; full-source-chart equivalence is not verified.
The remaining 13 cases stay blocked from chart-specific analysis.
